title: Dashboard: float(value) crashes on non-numeric SenML
description: In partial_metrics (app.py line 213), `_metrics_history[key].append(float(value))` is called without validating that value is numeric. If the CoAP node returns malformed SenML (e.g., a string value for a metric), this raises ValueError and returns 500 to the client. Should wrap in try/except or validate type before conversion.
